tool_args.rationale: Evidence supports a decaying signed input-step contribution plus a persistent state term. Fit these parameters numerically; predict currently needs access to the fitted training data, so the fit/predict interface should retain parameters internally.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; resulting eight rows provide signed-step and state variation across horizons.
Cannot explain the nonzero equal-input row where y equals x, nor the paired state-dependent residuals.
Opposing step shifts produce large sign-reversing outputs, inconsistent with dependence on x_now alone.
